_readme: RCF Online Academy - the single place where course information is kept.
TWO LISTS ARE IN THIS FILE:
courses  - the COURSES offered. Set "published": false to hide one
completely. A hidden course disappears from the menu and from
the site, so there is never an empty page for a course that is
not being taught.
classes  - the ACTUAL class entries shown on the site. Add one per course
you are running.
NEVER write a day, time, fee, location or number of places that has not been
decided. Leave the field out, or use one of these honest phrases:
"Schedule to be announced"
"Fees available on request"
"Registration opening soon"
registration may be: open | soon | waitlist | closed
delivery may be:     online | physical | hybrid
groupFormat may be:  individual | group
STARTING SOON (optional): to mark a class that is about to begin, give the
date twice - once for the machine, once for the reader:
"startDate": "Tuesday 6 October 2026",
startsOn must be yyyy-MM-dd. Within 60 days of that date the class is
marked "Starting soon" and moves to the top of the class list. After the
date passes the mark disappears by itself, so an old announcement can
never sit on the page claiming a class has not started.
POSTER (optional): "image", with "imageAlt" describing it for someone who
cannot see it. A standing poster - taller than it is wide, the shape made
for WhatsApp - also needs its real size, or the page will reserve the wrong
space for it while it loads:
"imageWidth": "1024",
"imageHeight": "1536",
PLACES REMAINING (optional): add both of these, and update them whenever
someone registers:
"placesRemaining": "3",
"placesUpdated": "2026-09-14"
The site shows "Only 3 places remaining (as of 14 September 2026)".
A count more than 30 days old is hidden automatically.
TESTIMONIALS (optional): only real words from real students, used with
their permission. Never write or improve one.
"testimonials": [{ "quote": "...", "name": "...", "detail": "2025 batch" }]
ABOUT THE TWO ELOCUTION DIPLOMAS - PLEASE READ BEFORE EDITING
These are PREPARATORY courses. RCF Online Academy teaches candidates for
the examinations of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and
Dramatic Art (CALSDA). CALSDA sets those examinations and awards the
diplomas.
Do NOT write anything suggesting that RCF Online Academy awards a diploma,
or that it is an official representative, agent or branch of CALSDA.
Do NOT state CALSDA entry requirements, syllabus content, examination
dates or fees here. Those belong to CALSDA and candidates must confirm
them with CALSDA directly.
After editing this file, run build.cmd.

classes.imageAlt: Poster for the CALSDA Primary Elocution Diploma course, showing a teacher speaking during an online class
classes.title: Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma
classes.subject: Elocution and speech training
description: A six-month professional preparatory course conducted by RCF Online Academy for candidates preparing to sit the Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma examination of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art (CALSDA).
The examination is set and the diploma awarded by CALSDA. RCF Online Academy prepares candidates for it and is not an official representative of CALSDA.
classes.audience: Candidates preparing for the CALSDA Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma examination
classes.materials: A notebook, a device with an internet connection and a working microphone
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like information about the Primary Elocution Teachers' Diploma preparatory course at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the schedule, fees and registration details.

classes.title: Associate Diploma (Higher Elocution Diploma)
classes.subject: Elocution and speech training
description: A six-month professional preparatory course conducted by RCF Online Academy for candidates preparing to sit the Associate Diploma, the higher elocution diploma examination of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art (CALSDA).
The examination is set and the diploma awarded by CALSDA. RCF Online Academy prepares candidates for it and is not an official representative of CALSDA.

classes.materials: A notebook, a device with an internet connection and a working microphone

classes.title: Grade 9 Literature
classes.subject: English Literature
description: An introduction to reading literature closely: poetry, short stories and drama, with the habits that make the Ordinary Level years easier. Students learn to find evidence in a text, explain an effect and build an answer rather than retell a story.
classes.materials: The prescribed texts, a notebook and a device with an internet connection
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello Miss Wasana, I would like information about the Grade 9 Literature class at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the schedule, fees and registration details.

classes.title: Grade 10 Literature
classes.subject: English Literature
description: The first year of the Ordinary Level course: close study of the prescribed poems, short stories, plays and novels, with regular practice in context answers and full essay answers, and individual correction of written work.
classes.materials: The prescribed texts, a notebook and a device with an internet connection
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello Miss Wasana, I would like information about the Grade 10 Literature class at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the schedule, fees and registration details.

classes.imageAlt: Poster for one-to-one IELTS training, showing a candidate in an online lesson with a headset and notes
classes.title: IELTS Training
classes.subject: IELTS preparation
description: A three-month IELTS course taught one to one, covering all four skills - listening, reading, writing and speaking.
Because it is individual, lessons are arranged at times that suit the candidate, and the work is aimed at the skills that particular candidate needs rather than at a fixed class syllabus.
classes.materials: A notebook, a device with an internet connection and a working microphone
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like information about the one-to-one IELTS course at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the available lesson times, fees and registration details.

classes.imageAlt: Poster for the TKT Teaching Knowledge Test course, showing a teacher leading a small group of adult trainees
classes.title: TKT: Teaching Knowledge Test
classes.subject: English teaching methodology
description: A six-month course preparing candidates for all three modules of the Cambridge Teaching Knowledge Test (TKT).
The TKT is awarded by Cambridge University Press & Assessment. RCF Online Academy prepares candidates for it and is not a test centre.
classes.materials: A notebook, a device with an internet connection and a working microphone
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like information about the TKT (Teaching Knowledge Test) course at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the starting date of the new batch, the fees and registration details.

classes.imageAlt: Poster for the O/L English Literature Paper Class at RCF Online Academy: a two-month online course starting Tuesday 6 October 2026, 6.00 to 8.00 p.m., limited to ten students
classes.title: O/L English Literature Paper Class
classes.subject: O/L English Literature
description: A focused two-month online course for students sitting the O/L English Literature paper. The work is answering technique, exam-oriented writing and paper practice done in class rather than set as homework.

Answering techniques and question analysis; guided practice in writing Literature answers; in-class writing and discussion; examination-focused preparation. The class is limited to ten students so that every answer can be read and corrected individually.
classes.audience: Grade 11 candidates and private candidates preparing for O/L English Literature
classes.materials: The prescribed texts, a notebook and a device with an internet connection
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to join the O/L English Literature Paper Class starting on 6 October. Please send me the registration details.

classes.imageAlt: Poster for the O/L and A/L Literature paper classes, showing a student writing answers during an online lesson
classes.title: A/L Literature
classes.subject: A/L English Literature
description: Advanced Level Literature: close reading, critical appreciation of unseen poems and passages, selecting and using textual evidence, and building well-organised essay answers under examination conditions.
classes.audience: Advanced Level students of English Literature
classes.materials: The prescribed texts and a device with an internet connection
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like information about the A/L Literature course at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the schedule, fees and registration details.

classes.title: Literature Orientation: One-Month Course for New Teachers
classes.subject: Teaching English Literature
description: A one-month orientation course for teachers who are new to teaching English Literature, and for teachers asked to take a Literature class for the first time.
It covers how a Literature lesson is planned and taught, how students are shown to build an answer rather than retell a story, and how written answers are marked and corrected.
classes.audience: Teachers new to teaching English Literature, and teachers taking a Literature class for the first time
classes.materials: A notebook and a device with an internet connection
classes.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like information about the Literature Orientation: One-Month Course for New Teachers at RCF Online Academy. Please send me the schedule, fees and registration details.
